title: Male Pharmacy Technician
qualification: Valid License/Certification as a Pharmacy Technician
description:
A community pharmacy located in **Ntinda** is hiring a **Male Pharmacy Technician** on a **full-time** basis to support daily dispensary operations and customer care.

**Location:** Ntinda (candidates must be residents of Ntinda and surrounding areas)

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Receive, process and dispense prescriptions accurately under the supervision of the pharmacist on duty
- Provide clear, friendly medication counselling and respond to customer enquiries at the counter
- Manage stock: receiving deliveries, organising shelves, monitoring expiry dates and supporting monthly stock takes
- Maintain accurate patient records, registers and electronic dispensing logs
- Uphold pharmacy hygiene, safety and confidentiality standards at all times
- Support the team with basic administrative tasks such as claims, receipts and daily reports

**Requirements:**
- Valid License/Certification as a Pharmacy Technician (must be current and verifiable)
- Previous experience working in a **community pharmacy** is preferred
- Strong communication and customer service skills
- Must be **male** (as stated by the employer)
- Must be a resident of **Ntinda or surrounding areas**
- Must be available to work **full-time shifts**, including weekdays and weekends as rostered
- Honest, reliable and able to work with minimal supervision

**Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Interview Date:** This **Thursday, 3rd September 2026**. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with the interview time and venue. Please ensure you are available on that date.

**How to Apply:**
Interested candidates should submit their **CV** and **copies of their pharmacy technician license/certification** via **WhatsApp to 0700828329**.

For any inquiries before applying, message the same number via WhatsApp.
